upgrades.name: Real-Time Face Render

upgrades.name: Watermark-Bypass Pipeline

generators.factoid: The January 21, 2024 Biden robocall in New Hampshire was the first U.S. presidential primary deepfake. The voice-clone generation step cost less than $1; an estimated 5,000-25,000 households received the call. The FCC declared AI-generated robocalls illegal 16 days later — a fast response that still trailed the cycle.

generators.display_name: Spin Up an AI News Farm

upgrades.name: Programmatic-Ad Laundering

upgrades.name: Citation-Loop Network

generators.factoid: NewsGuard's Unreliable AI-Generated News Sites tracker logged 49 such sites in May 2023 and surpassed 1,200 by mid-2024. Many monetise through programmatic advertising — Google's AdSense network has placed major-brand ads on UAINS-tracked sites that no human editor at the brand has ever reviewed.

upgrades.name: Fleet of 200 Accounts

generators.factoid: On October 27, 2022, Elon Musk closed the $44B Twitter acquisition. Within weeks, blue verification became a paid feature ($8/month). Within a month, paid-checkmark accounts impersonating Eli Lilly, Lockheed Martin, and major financial figures caused real stock movements. The verification signal that had taken 13 years to build collapsed in 30 days.

generators.factoid: The March 24, 2023 'Pope in a Balenciaga puffer' images (Midjourney v5, posted to Reddit) reached an estimated 20+ million impressions before major outlets identified the synthetic source. The images cost approximately 20¢ and 45 seconds to generate.

upgrades.name: Plausible-Citation Fabrication

upgrades.name: Speech-Writer Injection

generators.factoid: A 2023 Science Advances study (Spitale, Biller-Andorno, Germani) found that participants could not reliably distinguish LLM-generated political claims from human-written ones — and that LLM-generated false claims were rated MORE credible than human-written false claims. Detection-by-style approaches no longer scale.

generators.factoid: Musk's first year as Twitter/X owner: ~50% of staff laid off, Trust & Safety council disbanded, the API priced at ~$42,000/month (effectively ending external academic research on platform-level disinformation), and ad revenue down ~50%. Single-individual platform control with no inherited institutional resistance is the new structural condition.

prestige_bridge_copy: The model trains on its own output. The feed eats the feed. The synthetic intimates of strangers vote in your name. You begin again — older eras, younger hands, every technique you ever taught the machine still in its weights.
